The PMP® certification from the Project Management Institute validates your ability to lead these high-stakes initiatives, making it a meaningful credential for professionals seeking advancement in Honolulu's competitive and diverse sectors.

content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Honolulu

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus project-management experience, or a high school diploma with additional experience. Review PMI's education and hours requirements to confirm you qualify. Eligibility varies by credential level—verify yours before enrolling in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® Certification Training course. Attend all sessions from your Honolulu location on a schedule that fits your work calendar. You'll study the PMBOK® Guide and exam domains with active certified practitioners guiding you through real-world scenarios.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, create your PMI account and submit your official PMP® application, documenting your education and project-management experience. Pay the PMI exam fee and wait for PMI to approve your application before you can sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to strengthen weak areas. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing center. On exam day, demonstrate mastery of project-management knowledge and earn your PMP® credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) every three years by completing approved education, volunteering, or contributing to project-management knowledge. Renew your credential with PMI before expiration. Staying current keeps your certification active and signals commitment to your career.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
